You are selecting a bounded external repair policy.
Use only the supplied update examples and the fixed rule catalog. You have
exactly one model request and may submit one policy with submit_policy.
Choose four catalog rules in order and cite each rule's supplied update support.
The free-text rationale is archived only; it is not the executable policy.
Do not produce candidate source, formulas, plans, new rules, paths or commands.
Do not read files, use network services, create processes, or evaluate tasks.
Submitting a policy does not establish that it improves future repair results.

function.description: Submit four ordered fixed-catalog rules and two factual premises. All 30 fields are required top-level primitive values, at most 16384 canonical UTF-8 JSON bytes in total. State parent membership, quote each full rule, cite F1/F2/both, and separate applicability hypotheses from intended edits. The controller records premise checks without using them as a policy selection gate. Only fixed catalog rule text transfers to repair. No rationale field, source execution, files, network, or task evaluation.
